thread.title: Earnings Preview: What To Expect From Google-Parent Alphabet Today

author: Adam Sarhan
title: Earnings Preview: What To Expect From Google-Parent Alphabet Today
text:
Alphabet Inc is scheduled to release earnings after Monday's close. The stock hit a record high of $1291.44/share in 2018 and is currently trading near $1132/share. The stock is prone to big moves after reporting earnings and can easily gap up if the numbers are strong. Conversely, if the numbers disappoint, the stock can easily gap down. To help you prepare, here is what the Street is expecting:
Gallery: Top Four Google Gboard Tips 5 images View gallery
Earnings Preview:
Alphabet is expected to report earnings of $11.08/share on $31.28 billion in revenue. Meanwhile, the so-called Whisper number is $11.03. The Whisper number is the Street's unofficial view on earnings.
What The Pros Are Saying:
David Russell, Vice President, at TradeStation, an online stock brokerage firm told me via email, " Alphabet remains one of the market’s largest growth stocks. Even with some misses, GOOGL is till expected to grow EPS about 12 percent from a year ago. GOOGL tends to move less than AAPL and FB, and is down much less from last year’s highs. Unlike FB and AAPL, which faced major worries about key products, GOOGL has fewer fears priced in. This may mute price moves in GOOGL compared to FB or AAPL, which rallied from positions of extreme negativity ." David brings up a great point about who Google is trading compared to other so-called FAANG stocks.
Phillip Dickson, Co-Founder / Co-CEO, Vimvest, also talked about how Alphabet has traded compared to other FAANG stocks. Phillip said , “ Alphabet Inc. goes into earnings on a wave of positive news and is better positioned from other FAANG stocks because it has not guided lower. " Phillip also noted that both Apple and Facebook rallied after reporting earnings. Phillip also said, " The company has a pristine balance sheet (106B in cash), solid management, and a highly diversified portfolio of businesses. Given the recent positive reactions to FANG earnings, conditions are favorable for a positive reaction to GOOG earnings provided they don’t badly miss estimates, or provide downward guidance going forward. ”
Company Profile :
Here is a brief company profile courtesy of Thomson Reuters Eikon :
Alphabet Inc., incorporated on July 23, 2015, is a holding company. The Company holds interests in Google Inc. (Google). The Company's segments include Google and Other Bets. Google segment includes Internet products, such as Search, Ads, Commerce, Maps, YouTube, Apps, Cloud, Android, Chrome, Google Play, and hardware products, including Chromecast, Chromebooks and Nexus, which are sold by the Company. Its technical infrastructure and Virtual Reality are also included in Google segment. Google segment is engaged in advertising, sales of digital content, applications and cloud services, as well as sale of Google branded hardware. The Other Bets segment consists of various operating segments and includes businesses, such as Access/Google Fiber, Calico, Nest, Verily, GV, Google Capital, X and other initiatives. Other Bets segment is engaged in the sale of Nest hardware products, Internet and television services through Google Fiber, and licensing and research and development (R&D) services through Verily. Google offers products, including Gmail, which is an e-mail service; Chrome, which is a browser, and Google Play, which allows access to movies, books, music and application on various devices. Google offers platforms, including Chrome OS and Android mobile operating system. The Company offers advertising solutions for businesses with a range of products across screens and devices. It delivers performance advertising and brand advertising. Its performance advertising lets its advertisers connect with users.
Competitors:
Alphabet competes with Yahoo, Microsoft, Yandex, Baidu, Naver, WebCrawler, MyWebSearch, Kayak, LinkedIn, WebMD, Amazon, eBay, Facebook, Twitter, Criteo and AppNexus, just to name a few
Pay Attention To How The Stock Reacts To The News :
From where I sit, the most important trait I look for during earnings season is how the market and a specific company reacts to the news.
